breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) on the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Neumann conditions. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Neumann boundary conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency in alignment with the ground truth.
